All returned products are processed via Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) prior to return shipment. Contact our Support department ( support @ puri . sm ) to request an RMA. All RMAs must be requested within 14 calendar days from initial date of delivery. Return shipments must then be postmarked within 3 calendar days of RMA receipt. All returns are subject to Purism’s quality inspection and must be evaluated as like-new or better condition. All returns not resulting from mistakes in configuration or packaging by Purism incur a 20% restocking fee. All returns must be returned in the original packaging with all original contents included. All defective hardware products or components identified by Purism will be replaced with a replacement product or component free of charge. See the Warranty section for details. Clauses A defective item return request will be denied if: Return shipment was received without prior authorization. Device has signs of damage caused by mishandling or misuse. Device was modified to temporarily or permanently alter functionality or capability in any way. A defective item return request may be denied if: Customer does not perform troubleshooting steps instructed by Purism. Customer fails to ensure proper packaging of the device resulting in damage during transit. Customer fails to include original packaging with all contents in original configuration. Refunds # Refunds are processed through the original payment method
